name: Harpy
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
interaction: Chooses a first player (MAD) then a second player (2ND). The MAD player is woken, shown the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Harpy token, and shown the 2ND player.
drunk_or_poisoned: The Storyteller may still wake the chosen player as normal, but no madness applies and the Storyteller may not kill either player for breaking it.

rulings.text: The Harpy chooses one player at a time, not two at once.
A chosen player stays affected until the Harpy's next choice.
If the MAD player breaks madness, the Storyteller may kill one, both, or neither of the two players.
If a dead player is chosen, only the living player can be killed.
The Storyteller chooses the order of deaths if it matters.
The Harpy is not in the townsquare roles.json night order; the official night sheet places it between the Fearmonger and the Mezepheles on both nights, hence the half positions.

test_scenarios.name: madness kept

test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Hal chooses Jo then Kim. Day 1: Jo breaks madness; Storyteller (scripted) kills only Kim.
